title: Reference solution: Integrate Bootstrap styling into a framework-based frontend
answer:
Framework integration plan:
- Let the framework own component state and rendered DOM.
- use bootstrap CSS classes where useful.
- If Bootstrap JavaScript is required, initialize only a clearly separated subtree and clean up listeners/instances as the framework lifecycle requires.
- Test state changes, route changes, responsive layouts, and disposal.
explanation: This repository-only reference provides one compact implementation pattern for integrate bootstrap styling into a framework-based frontend. It demonstrates core acceptance markers but is not a substitute for runtime, responsive, accessibility, and human review. Accept equivalent solutions that meet all criteria.
